metadata.title: Equipment Inventory Ingestion Backlog and Source Map
metadata.purpose: Guide completion of public system/platform/variant-level equipment inventories and simulation capability mappings for every indexed entity.
metadata.safety_note: All ingestion tasks must exclude live basing, tasking, readiness rates not publicly disclosed, targeting data, exploitable vulnerabilities, classified/leaked material, software/network architecture, credentials, frequencies, and exploit paths.

global_source_priority.use_for: official force structure, procurement, delivery, retirement, modernization, and branch naming
reported conventional arms transfers and state-declared holdings where submitted
official ATT state-party annual import/export reports and report-status coverage
official government-submitted military expenditure reports and nil-report status
NATO member defense spending, personnel, GDP share, and equipment expenditure fields
EU defense spending, personnel, investment, R&D, and benchmark indicators
population, GDP, energy, transport, armed-forces personnel, military expenditure, and macro denominators
country-level logistics, infrastructure, timeliness, customs, and supply-chain modifiers
budget context and cross-checking procurement affordability; not usually platform inventory counts
annual platform inventory estimates where legally accessible; store only concise derived facts
aircraft fleets, orders, and deliveries where public/accessible
ship classes, commissioned/decommissioned status, hull counts at non-live level
contract/order/delivery quantities and lifecycle status
U.S. foreign military sale notifications by country, system, package, value, and date
historical U.S. security cooperation sales totals and FMS context
official customs trade flows for arms/ammunition categories; only indirect evidence of inventory
monthly official military/police contribution snapshots to UN missions
legal obligations, treaty participation, reservations, and international-law constraints
regional transparency, notification, inspection, and military-information-exchange framework metadata
nuclear safeguards and non-proliferation legal context at non-sensitive abstraction
public port and maritime infrastructure context for logistics modeling
standardized foreign geographic names and feature aliases
terrain and land-cover modifiers for geography/environment categories
global elevation and slope-derived movement constraints
structured public entity/equipment alias discovery and crosswalks
structured public encyclopedia-derived discovery and alias enrichment
high-level military organization and public country context, not detailed inventory
low-confidence seed pointers only; replace during review

source_discovery_batches.covers: Global or near-global official reporting for arms transfers, expenditure, peacekeeping contributions, treaty/legal posture, and nuclear safeguards context.
source_discovery_batches.limitations: Many instruments are voluntary, incomplete, delayed, aggregated, or not platform-inventory sources. Treat them as official evidence with coverage gaps, not exhaustive truth.
source_discovery_batches.next_ingestion_step: Implement per-source harvesters that preserve report year, submitting state, reporting status, category code, and original source URL or document locator.

source_discovery_batches.covers: Regional alliance/agency data for defense spending, personnel, investment, exports, and military-transparency frameworks.
source_discovery_batches.limitations: Regional membership limits coverage. Do not project NATO/EDA definitions onto non-members without a separate source.
source_discovery_batches.next_ingestion_step: Create NATO/EDA parsers for published spreadsheets/PDF tables and attach definition/version notes to every normalized row.

source_discovery_batches.covers: Official national procurement, delivery, contract, foreign military sales, naval-register, and lifecycle records.
source_discovery_batches.limitations: National publication styles differ; contract awards and sale notifications are not proof of fielded inventory until delivery/acceptance is separately sourced.
source_discovery_batches.next_ingestion_step: Build source adapters that produce review queues with system name, customer country, quantity, value, lifecycle event, date, and row-level locator.

source_discovery_batches.covers: Ports, geographic names, logistics-performance indicators, land cover, elevation, slope, and other non-operational geography modifiers.
source_discovery_batches.limitations: These are terrain and infrastructure context sources, not live military route, basing, depot, or targeting datasets.
source_discovery_batches.next_ingestion_step: Add derived geography tables only after deciding the simulation resolution; store product version, tile/query, date, and transformation method.

source_discovery_batches.covers: Public encyclopedic graph and archive sources for aliases, entity links, historical context, equipment pages, and source discovery.
source_discovery_batches.limitations: Use as discovery/staging and alias normalization unless a row is verified by a primary or stronger secondary source.
source_discovery_batches.next_ingestion_step: Generate alias/crosswalk tables for countries, armed services, equipment systems, manufacturers, and variant labels.

source_discovery_batches.covers: Established research/reference sources that are often more complete for platform inventories and longitudinal military spending than official public reporting alone.
source_discovery_batches.limitations: Some sources are licensed or subscription-based; store only compliant concise derived facts and cite accessible pages or licensed references.
source_discovery_batches.next_ingestion_step: Use these as reconciliation and completeness checks after official-source ingestion.

capability_ingestion_order: map equipment rows to safe capability definitions
add public software and data-link program families
map software rows to C2, ISR, logistics, EW, cyber-defense, or training capabilities
add entity-level capabilities such as reserve law, alliance interoperability, strategic lift, and public nuclear deterrence
add injection action templates only when preconditions and failure modes can be represented abstractly

coverage_batches.first_pass_goal: Top-level inventories for air, naval, armor, artillery, GBAD, missiles, and nuclear delivery systems where public.
Date-bound, non-live inventories with conservative confidence and explicit nulls for active/readiness counts.

coverage_batches.entity_filter: UN member states with NATO/EU defense reporting not already seeded
coverage_batches.first_pass_goal: Official annual defense reports, budget annexes, air force public summaries, naval registers.
Aircraft, ships, armored vehicles, artillery/MLRS, GBAD, and coast guard militarized assets.

coverage_batches.entity_filter: MENA entities excluding already seeded Iran and Israel
coverage_batches.first_pass_goal: Major land/air/naval systems and public procurement deliveries.
Air/naval fleets, armored vehicles, militarized coast guard/security assets.

coverage_batches.entity_filter: Sub-Saharan African UN member states plus Somaliland where tracked
coverage_batches.first_pass_goal: Sparse public inventories, prioritizing official statements, UNROCA, and reputable public summaries.
Only public, high-level equipment families; avoid sponsor-state live disposition assumptions.

coverage_batches.entity_filter: Entities with no regular armed forces or very small security forces
coverage_batches.first_pass_goal: Mark public military data availability and security/coast guard assets where militarized.

row_acceptance_checks: category is one of the schema categories
confidence is low, medium, or high
estimate_type is reported, estimated_range, qualitative_assessment, model_parameter, or unknown
unknown counts are null, not zero or string values
notes do not include live basing, tasking, vulnerabilities, or targeting detail
capability_acceptance_checks: capability definition uses abstract effect inputs and outputs
software rows avoid architecture, network, credential, frequency, vulnerability, and exploit details
asset_capability_map rows cite source_id, as_of_date, confidence, and estimate_type
capability_level is ordinal, not a fabricated precision score
effect parameters do not include targeting data, route planning, live readiness, or weapon employment instructions
injection action templates include safety_boundary and preconditions
